references.text: Matt 8:17 refers to Isaiah 53:4 and explains that Jesus' healings were a sign that he bore our diseases, which supports his authority to forgive sins.
Psalm 103:3 speaks of God who forgives all your iniquity and heals all your diseases, reflecting Jesus' actions and authority in Matt 9:6.
Micah 7:18 highlights God's unique ability to forgive sins, which is relevant to Jesus' claim of authority to forgive sins on earth.
In Matt 9:2 we see a direct connection where Jesus first forgives the man's sins before healing him, emphasizing his authority to forgive sins.
Luke 5:20-24 parallels the event in Matt 9:6, where Jesus forgives sins and heals a paralyzed man as proof of his divine authority.
John 8:10-11 refers to another incident where Jesus forgives sins, emphasizing his authority and ability to forgive sins, similar to Matt 9:6.
